description: Give the SMS code the user received to the apply AI, the same as typing it into the code box at the top of the app's main window: if the AI is still waiting, the code goes straight to that wait and the turn continues; if the wait has ended, it is sent to that conversation as a message. taskId can be omitted when only one application is waiting; pass it when several are (see get_job_apply_client_status). Says so if nothing is waiting for a code. Replies with the employer / role it went to. Requires the AceRound Auto Apply desktop app on the user’s computer to be signed in and open (running in the background after closing the window also works); if the app is offline or outdated, the tool says so. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)
name: submit_job_apply_sms_code
